name: codejustwrite-monorepo
description: CodeJustWrite — local AI coding agent with a terminal CLI, a phone-installable PWA, and a native desktop app.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@codejustwrite/core && npm run build --workspace=@codejustwrite/cli && npm run build --workspace=@codejustwrite/server && npm run build --workspace=@codejustwrite/web
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:core && npm run build:server && npm run build:web && npm run build --workspace=@codejustwrite/desktop
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:core && npm run build:server && npm run build:web && npm run dev --workspace=@codejustwrite/desktop
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run package --workspace=@codejustwrite/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@codejustwrite/core && npm run test --workspace=@codejustwrite/server && npm run test:unit --workspace=@codejustwrite/web && npm run test --workspace=@codejustwrite/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@codejustwrite/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@codejustwrite/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace=@codejustwrite/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@codejustwrite/desktop
